V5.4 CRITICAL BUG (demo_seed.py visibility → GET /api/campaigns/{cid} 500) is FIXED — visibility='private' now set in demo_seed.py line 252 and routes/campaigns.py uses camp.get('visibility','private'). ui_bugs.issue: On mobile (<768px) the compact mode-switch buttons [data-testid=map-mode-fog] and [data-testid=map-mode-wall] still render (count=1 each). Only the map-gm-tools parent (line 533) and fullscreen-toggle (line 517) are gated with !isMobile. The small header mode buttons are not. Functionally safe because the useEffect at line 73 auto-resets mode to 'select' on mobile, but the buttons being visible contradicts the 'locked view-only' spec. Wrap the select/fog/wall/measure mode-button group with `{!isMobile && (...)}` or render only select on mobile.

action_items: (LOW) Wrap the inline mode-switch button cluster in Battlemap.jsx (map-mode-select/fog/wall/measure around lines 486-505) with `!isMobile` so mobile users can't see the fog/wall tools. Current behaviour is functionally safe (auto-reset to select) but visible buttons contradict the view-only spec.

Battlemap.jsx fullscreen auto-engage logic (useEffect watching isEditingMode + !isMobile) works as specified; ESC handler correctly bound; overlay computed as position:fixed, z-index:60, bg rgb(0,0,0), inset 0 — exactly per spec.
